user_verbatim_decision: oauth 인증받은 codex, claude, agy --dangerously-skip-permissions 이용한 cli 로 실험
decision_effect: This amendment replaces the strict-API-only route for the new stage. It authorizes source-bound feasibility scheduling through authenticated native Codex, Claude and agy CLIs only; it does not itself authorize a provider call or any assignment launch.

freeze_contract.assignment_formula: 9 exact candidates x 2 independent task arms (C1,B1) x 2 representations (general_rule,ontology) = 36
freeze_contract.counterpart_arm_rule: Within a candidate, C1 and B1 remain scheduled independently regardless of the other arm's raw validity or status.
freeze_contract.withheld_payloads: No C2, H1 or other held-out task payload is included in this freeze.

no_execution_statement: This owner created only authorization and frozen-input artifacts; no model call, provider request, generated-code execution, build, QA, deployment, retry, resume or fallback occurred.
supersedes: strict-api-only route for the new native stage; old API route was never called and is retired with review block

assignment_policy.stage_calls: F1 general_rule then F2 ontology; F2 remains predeclared even when an F1 raw result is invalid, but launch gate is checked independently.

permission_factor.description: CLI permission and sandbox mode is a declared system/agent-mediated factor. It is not a pure-model factor and does not establish model or ontology causal efficacy.

candidate_contract.missing_fields_rule: Keep null; never infer, substitute, or normalize a requested label into a provider result.

cli_entrypoints_source: NativeOAuthTransport IRC receipt 2026-10-24; source-supported help only

codex.oauth: normal native Codex home/store; do not read auth file

claude.sandbox: provider/CLI permission mode only; no host-wide bypass added
claude.oauth: normal native Claude home/store; do not read auth file
claude.safe_mode_note: --safe-mode is OAuth-compatible but is not used for this explicit dangerous-permission lane because it disables customization.

agy.oauth: normal native agy home/store; do not read auth file
agy.b1_plan_mode: Use only if the exact existing probe/help receipt proves the flag; otherwise omit and record unverified.

environment_projection.recording_rule: Record removed variable names and counts only; never persist secret values.

caps_and_billing.interpretation: USD 100 is planning context only; it is not a fake price reserve, per-run guard, or proof that calls are funded.

scope_and_legacy.old_argon_attempts: separate historical feasibility artifacts; immutable; never new results or independent repeats
scope_and_legacy.old_api_attempt: never called; retired with review block; not a source-efficacy result

launch_boundary.C1_B1_raw_validity_coupling: none; within each candidate both arms remain scheduled regardless raw validity of the counterpart
